Name: Maraith Meadow - Mountain farm map
Author: Lykkio
Description:
A simple farm intended as a bit of a blank slate for large decorating projects. I wanted to learn to use some of the wonderful tools provided by Mushymato and figured others might enjoy this map. 

This farm replaces the standard farm. All water in the map should have the same mountain fish. The little hidden grotto in the southeast has a swimming spot which can restore energy, and the cave is entered by interacting with the mushroom instead of walking in. Blue grass will be present from the start, and the top and bottom half of the map have invisible animal barriers between them so animals will stay on whichever half they are placed.

Also featured, thanks to MMAP:
Panorama
Mood lighting
froge

Welcome to your new home in the clouds :)

There is no custom farm cave or starting house decor associated with this map.
